question: Should OpenClaw retain `agents.defaults.models` as the canonical home for aliases and per-model settings, or sponsor a breaking migration to a different metadata schema?
rationale: Current main has already separated the reported allowlist behavior, but removing the remaining map would alter documented user configuration and needs a deliberate long-term owner and migration target.

options.title: Retain the split
options.body: Keep `agents.defaults.models` for aliases and per-model settings, and direct users who want dynamic availability to omit `modelPolicy.allow` or use provider wildcards.

options.title: Design a successor schema
options.body: Define a replacement for aliases and per-model settings, then ship a bounded Doctor migration, compatibility documentation, and upgrade coverage before retiring the map.

recommendation.title: Retain the split
recommendation.body: Keep `agents.defaults.models` for aliases and per-model settings, and direct users who want dynamic availability to omit `modelPolicy.allow` or use provider wildcards.

likelyOwner.reason: The visible repository policy establishes the required configuration-migration direction, making this the best available routing candidate.
